label: The shipped AGENTS.md delivery-budget canary is red at v4.0.2.0 and HEAD: agents-md-manifest.cjs --check exits 1 with 'history: the recorded body 865f058927ed is no longer released' because 9d4edcbd3b (2026-11-08, an ancestor of v4.0.2.0) edited AGENTS.md to 27587 bytes without regenerating the manifest derived.history; the remedy the tool prints (--write) would record the unreleased body as acceptable, erasing the evidence.

No .github/workflows file references agents-md-manifest or agents-md-check (grep over 33 workflows returns nothing), so the red AGENTS.md canary ships unseen; the engine was introduced at e0fb2624dd (2026-10-30) and first shipped in v4.0.1.0. The contrast is agent-mirror-sync.yml:57, which does wire its sibling checker and states 'Fail closed in CI', so the repository already holds the policy the AGENTS.md canary breaks.

The 16KB AGENTS.md cut is a designed constraint, not unmanaged drift: agents-md-manifest.json:14 states max_bytes 32768 beside prefix_bytes 16384 and agents-md-manifest.cjs:317 encodes the delivery-anchor intent that the deepest anchor bounds how much a truncating runtime delivers. Three commits (14729099c9, 9f433e6530, 0948abef32) assert that invariant while the one script meant to check it is red and unwired, so no release from v4.0.1.0 onward can assert the anchors stay inside the prefix. This corrects f-iter003-001's mechanism, not its measurement: awk still puts the 16,384th byte at line 180, inside section 3.

f-iter002-001 needs narrowing: agent-mirror-sync.yml:57 runs check-agent-mirror-sync.cjs on every PR touching an agent path, so the implied 'nothing runs the crosswalk checker' is wrong; what CI does not do is run --all, so an agent body that drifted before the PR stays invisible to both surfaces. The gap survives as 'changed-file in CI, absent in doctor', not 'absent everywhere'.

Tag object SHAs differ from the brief's commit SHAs because the tags are annotated; the ladder must be built with rev-parse <tag>^{commit}. Peeled commits match the brief's list exactly, which validates the ladder independently. v4.0.0.4 through v4.0.0.10 all peel to 4d8f403355 dated 2026-10-14, confirming the single-commit fan-out.

Of eleven attributed findings, five first ship in v4.0.0.0 and only one (d93100d57b, 2026-10-11) lands in the collapsed v4.0.0.4-.10 window, so the window the brief warned about is nearly empty of defects while the v4.0.0.0 consolidation carries the mass. Four findings share the 2026-08-31 to 2026-09-17 portability window that precedes the first tag.

Piping agents-md-manifest.cjs --check into head reported EXIT=0 while the engine actually returned 1; the status captured was head's. Re-running without a pipe gave REAL_EXIT=1. Direct confirmation that exit status must be read without a pipeline stage between the command and $?.
A finding's release value must name exactly one release tag that contains the introducing commit, proven with git merge-base --is-ancestor, not inferred from the commit date.
A shipped checker that is not invoked by any workflow cannot gate a release, regardless of what its exit code would say.
